coupling: The earlier Index maintenance commit raises the default Record-group allocation from 512 to 1024. The later commit stores that allocation count in a 10-bit field while routing initialization and resets through lzma_index_prealloc(). Either edit alone supports a nonzero allocation count: 1024 fits the original size_t field, and 512 fits the narrowed field. Together, 1024 wraps to zero; lzma_index_append() allocates only the group header and writes its first Record past the heap allocation. Repair requires reconciling the group-size bound with the preallocation field and its consumers across both commits.
